title: What Happens If You're Thrown Into Space?
hook: If an airlock burst, what would happen to you?
script: If an airlock burst, what would happen to you? You wouldn’t freeze solid or explode. Instead, you would remain conscious for about 15 seconds. During this time, your body struggles without oxygen. As the pressure drops, your blood begins to boil, a phenomenon known as ebullism. This unsettling reaction happens because the vacuum of space causes the water in your body to vaporize at body temperature. In a NASA test in 1966, a subject experienced this, feeling saliva bubbling on his tongue before losing consciousness. Imagine the sensation of your own blood boiling, trapped in a void where life cannot survive.
